mapper.select: select plant_cd as code, plant_nm as name from sys_plant where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, plant_cd
select class_id as id, class_cd as code, class_nm as name from mst_equip_class where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, class_cd
select class_id from mst_equip_class where class_cd = #{classCd} and use_yn = 'Y'
select hb_code_usable(hb_current_comp(), #{grp}, #{code})
select exists (select 1 from sys_numbering_rule where rule_cd = #{ruleCd})
mapper.sql: f.fail_id, f.code_type, f.fail_cd, f.fail_nm, f.fail_cat, f.equip_class_id, c.class_cd as equip_class_cd, c.class_nm as equip_class_nm, f.sort_no, f.use_yn, f.remark, f.row_ver, f.updated_at, f.updated_by
mapper.select:
select
order by f.code_type, f.sort_no, f.fail_cd

select
order by
f.fail_cd desc f.fail_nm desc f.fail_cat desc nulls last c.class_cd desc nulls last f.sort_no desc f.use_yn desc f.code_type desc ,
f.fail_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*)

insert into cms_fail_code (comp_cd, code_type, fail_cd, fail_nm, fail_cat, equip_class_id, sort_no, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.codeType}, #{f.failCd}, #{f.failNm}, #{f.failCat}, #{f.equipClassId}, #{f.sortNo}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning fail_id
mapper.sql: e.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, e.plant_cd, c.class_cd, c.class_nm, h.node_cd as location_cd, e.use_yn as equip_use_yn, p.row_ver, coalesce(p.criticality, 'C') as criticality, coalesce(p.key_equip_yn, 'N') as key_equip_yn, p.owner_user_id, u.login_id as owner_login_id, u.user_nm as owner_nm, p.ideal_ct_sec, p.remark, p.updated_at, p.updated_by, (select count(*) from cms_mwo m where m.equip_id = e.equip_id and m.status in ('REQ', 'OPEN', 'WIP')) as open_mwo_cnt

from mst_equip e join mst_equip_class c on c.class_id = e.class_id left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = e.node_id left join cms_equip_profile p on p.equip_id = e.equip_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.owner_user_id
mapper.select:
select
order by
e.equip_cd desc e.equip_nm desc c.class_cd desc h.node_cd desc nulls last coalesce(p.criticality, 'C') desc coalesce(p.key_equip_yn, 'N') desc u.user_nm desc nulls last e.plant_cd desc ,
e.equip_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*)
select where e.equip_id = #{equipId}
mapper.insert: insert into cms_equip_profile (equip_id, comp_cd, criticality, key_equip_yn, owner_user_id, ideal_ct_sec, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (#{equipId}, hb_current_comp(), #{criticality}, #{keyEquipYn}, #{ownerUserId}, #{idealCtSec}, #{remark}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.select: select a.asset_cd, a.asset_nm, a.asset_type, i.installed_at from mst_asset_install i join mst_phys_asset a on a.asset_id = i.asset_id where i.equip_id = #{equipId} and i.removed_at is null and i.void_yn = 'N' order by a.asset_type, a.asset_cd
mapper.sql: select 'EQUIP' as target_type, e.equip_id as id, e.equip_cd as code, e.equip_nm as name, e.plant_cd, e.class_id, c.class_nm, null as asset_type, h.node_cd as location_cd, h.node_nm as location_nm, e.use_yn from mst_equip e join mst_equip_class c on c.class_id = e.class_id left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = e.node_id

select 'ASSET' as target_type, a.asset_id as id, a.asset_cd as code, a.asset_nm as name, (select e.plant_cd from mst_asset_install i join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = i.equip_id where i.asset_id = a.asset_id and i.removed_at is null and i.void_yn = 'N' limit 1) as plant_cd, null::bigint as class_id, null as class_nm, a.asset_type, null as location_cd, null as location_nm, a.use_yn from mst_phys_asset a
mapper.select: where e.equip_id = #{id}

select f.fail_cd as symptom_cd, f.fail_nm as symptom_nm from cms_fail_code f where f.code_type = 'SYMPTOM' and f.use_yn = 'Y' and (f.equip_class_id is null or f.equip_class_id = (select e.class_id from mst_equip e where e.equip_id = #{equipId})) and exists (select 1 from mst_equip e where e.equip_id = #{equipId} and e.use_yn = 'Y') order by f.sort_no, f.fail_cd
select exists (select 1 from mst_worker w where w.worker_id = #{workerId} and w.use_yn = 'Y')
select t.terminal_cd as code, t.plant_cd as name from sys_terminal t where t.terminal_id = #{terminalId}
select m.mwo_no from cms_mwo m where m.report_req_id = #{reqId}
select m.mwo_id, m.mwo_type, m.status, m.reported_terminal_id, m.report_req_id from cms_mwo m where m.mwo_no = #{mwoNo} for update
where e.equip_cd = #{code}
where a.asset_cd = #{code}
mapper.sql: m.mwo_id, m.mwo_no, m.mwo_type, m.plant_cd, m.target_type, m.equip_id, m.asset_id, coalesce(e.equip_cd, a.asset_cd) as target_cd, coalesce(e.equip_nm, a.asset_nm) as target_nm, e.class_id as target_class_id, m.title, m.priority, m.status, m.reported_at, m.requested_by, ru.login_id as requested_login_id, ru.user_nm as requested_nm, m.reported_worker_id, rw.worker_cd as reported_worker_cd, rw.worker_nm as reported_worker_nm, m.reported_terminal_id, rt.terminal_cd as reported_terminal_cd, m.report_req_id, m.symptom_id, fs.fail_cd as symptom_cd, fs.fail_nm as symptom_nm, m.symptom_text, m.assignee_id, au.login_id as assignee_login_id, au.user_nm as assignee_nm, m.due_date, m.started_at, m.finished_at, m.down_yn, m.down_start_at, m.down_end_at, m.cause_id, fc.fail_cd as cause_cd, fc.fail_nm as cause_nm, m.action_id, fa.fail_cd as action_cd, fa.fail_nm as action_nm, m.work_text, m.cancel_reason, m.closed_at, m.fail_mech_cd, m.fail_detect_cd, m.fail_impact_cd, cu.login_id as closed_login_id, m.parent_mwo_id, pm.mwo_no as parent_mwo_no, m.pm_plan_id, m.due_ref_date, m.due_ref_usage, m.src_run_id, (select coalesce(sum(l.minutes), 0) from cms_mwo_labor l where l.mwo_id = m.mwo_id) as labor_min, m.row_ver, m.updated_at, m.updated_by

from cms_mwo m left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = m.equip_id left join mst_phys_asset a on a.asset_id = m.asset_id left join sys_user ru on ru.user_id = m.requested_by left join mst_worker rw on rw.worker_id = m.reported_worker_id left join sys_terminal rt on rt.terminal_id = m.reported_terminal_id left join sys_user au on au.user_id = m.assignee_id left join sys_user cu on cu.user_id = m.closed_by left join cms_fail_code fs on fs.fail_id = m.symptom_id left join cms_fail_code fc on fc.fail_id = m.cause_id left join cms_fail_code fa on fa.fail_id = m.action_id left join cms_mwo pm on pm.mwo_id = m.parent_mwo_id
mapper.select:
select
order by
m.mwo_no desc m.mwo_type desc coalesce(e.equip_cd, a.asset_cd) desc nulls last m.title desc m.priority desc m.status desc m.due_date desc nulls last m.reported_at desc ,
m.mwo_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*)
select where m.mwo_id = #{id}
select mwo_id from cms_mwo where mwo_id = #{id} for update
select mwo_type || ':' || status from cms_mwo where mwo_id = #{id}
select mwo_id from cms_mwo where mwo_id = #{id} for share

insert into cms_mwo (comp_cd, mwo_no, mwo_type, plant_cd, target_type, equip_id, asset_id, title, priority, status, reported_at, requested_by, symptom_id, symptom_text, assignee_id, due_date, down_yn, down_start_at, down_end_at, parent_mwo_id, pm_plan_id, due_ref_date, due_ref_usage, src_run_id, reported_worker_id, reported_terminal_id, report_req_id, fail_mech_cd, fail_detect_cd, fail_impact_cd, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{m.mwoNo}, #{m.mwoType}, #{m.plantCd}, #{m.targetType}, #{m.equipId}, #{m.assetId}, #{m.title}, #{m.priority}, #{m.status}, #{m.reportedAt}, #{m.requestedBy}, #{m.symptomId}, #{m.symptomText}, #{m.assigneeId}, #{m.dueDate}, #{m.downYn}, #{m.downStartAt}, #{m.downEndAt}, #{m.parentMwoId}, #{m.pmPlanId}, #{m.dueRefDate}, #{m.dueRefUsage}, #{m.srcRunId}, #{m.reportedWorkerId}, #{m.reportedTerminalId}, #{m.reportReqId}, #{m.failMechCd}, #{m.failDetectCd}, #{m.failImpactCd}, #{by}, #{by}) returning mwo_id
mapper.update: update cms_mwo set title = #{m.title}, priority = #{m.priority}, status = #{m.status}, reported_at = #{m.reportedAt}, symptom_id = #{m.symptomId}, symptom_text = #{m.symptomText}, assignee_id = #{m.assigneeId}, due_date = #{m.dueDate}, started_at = #{m.startedAt}, finished_at = #{m.finishedAt}, down_yn = #{m.downYn}, down_start_at = #{m.downStartAt}, down_end_at = #{m.downEndAt}, cause_id = #{m.causeId}, action_id = #{m.actionId}, work_text = #{m.workText}, cancel_reason = #{m.cancelReason}, closed_at = #{m.closedAt}, closed_by = #{closedBy}, fail_mech_cd = #{m.failMechCd}, fail_detect_cd = #{m.failDetectCd}, fail_impact_cd = #{m.failImpactCd}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where mwo_id = #{m.mwoId} and row_ver = #{m.rowVer}
mapper.select: select l.labor_id, l.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_nm, l.work_date, l.minutes, l.remark, l.created_by from cms_mwo_labor l join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.user_id where l.mwo_id = #{mwoId} order by l.work_date, l.labor_id

insert into cms_mwo_labor (comp_cd, mwo_id, user_id, work_date, minutes, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{mwoId}, #{userId}, #{workDate}, #{minutes}, #{remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning labor_id
mapper.delete: delete from cms_mwo_labor where labor_id = #{laborId} and mwo_id = #{mwoId}
